items.text: Dinner with my aunt this Thursday, she's picking the restaurant and I'm already dreading it.
My landlord finally fixed the heater after three weeks, so annoying that it took that long.
Rose and I are driving up to Lake Tahoe the day after tomorrow, can't wait!
I told Hope about the job offer last Monday and she cried happy tears.
items.note: name that is a word; others' emotion not labelled

items.text: Sunny from my pottery class brought homemade dumplings today, that was so sweet of her.
Been listening to Taylor Swift all week, she just gets me.
I keep thinking about Sherlock Holmes, I wish I was half as observant as him.
Played Vertigo by U2 on repeat all morning and now I want to rewatch the Hitchcock film Vertigo too.
Saw Parasite again the other day, that stairs scene still gets me.
I'm moving to Osaka next summer, still can't believe it!
Halloween party at Marcus's place, he's making everyone dress up as 90s cartoon characters.
Nobody has texted me all weekend and I just stared at the ceiling for hours.
Can you remind me to call Dmitri on Feb 14? It's his birthday.
Just passed my driving test!!! Finally!
What's a good way to keep bread from going stale?
hold on, someone's at the door
My boss moved the deadline to tomorrow and I haven't slept properly in days.
Walked around Lake Geneva with my brother yesterday, it was so peaceful.
My grandpa used to hum Moon River while cooking. I miss him so much.
We call our couch the big marshmallow, and Priya and I are binge-watching Succession on it in two days.
